question: Is the acceptance-criteria gap the binding constraint for the frozen Qwen3.6-27B + L1 Pi harness on OfficeVal DEV9, and do existing text-contract (PSCI-style) or render-check (GDPval-style) instructions close it?

reference_prospective_freeze.use: DEV45 task configuration hashes, Actor image/user/environment, native validator identity and expected vLLM service identity; its controller-source lock is superseded by the Exp1 plan's own source fingerprints

reference_cohort.use: historical O reference for the drift check only; never pooled into the primary contrast

pi.condition_injection: agent.system_prompt: the condition text is inserted between the Pi base system prompt and the sandbox execution contract block. L1 rebuilds the contract block idempotently, and Pi compaction keeps messages[0:2] (system + task), so the text stays visible for the whole run; a user-turn injection would be summarized away by compaction. Only agent.system_prompt differs from O; O is hash-equal to the DEV45 frozen task configuration.
pi.controller_source_drift: Since the DEV45 execution commit 8d32bdb only three execution-path files changed: core/orchestrator.py (actor-transition and OpenCode output-limit paths, gated to the opencode-chat adapter), models/opencode.py (not used by this openai-compatible configuration) and runtime/pi_native_validation.py (pipe cleanup on bridge errors). The Exp1 plan fingerprints the current sources; the drift check against DEV45 O measures any behavioural effect.

tasks.f_only_reason: The officeval_085 verifier requires three exact deliverable filenames that neither the task text nor the official runner prompt states, and it has no fallback. O, T and V are 0 by construction there, so only F is run, as a diagnostic of performance once the names are known.

F.label: full grader specification at start (information upper bound)
F.prefix: 下面是本任务交付物的验收标准。评分时会逐条检查这些标准（评分器本身仍不可调用）。完成任务时请满足这些标准。

source.note: Verbatim requirement lists of the frozen D1 R_implicit arm (explicit task requirements plus exact verifier specifications), without the D/S process sentences.

T.label: self-written acceptance contract (PSCI-style text baseline)
T.text: 开始修改之前，先根据任务说明和 /workspace/input 中的全部输入材料（包括图片和原始文档），整理一份这份交付物的验收清单：逐条写出交付物必须满足的具体、可检查的要求，例如要保持或达到的格式、数值、位置、结构和完整性要求。把清单保存为 /workspace/acceptance_contract.md，不要放进 /workspace/submission。完成修改后、结束之前，逐条对照这份清单检查交付物；有不满足的就修改并重新保存，直到每一条都满足后再结束。

V.label: render-and-inspect self-check (GDPval-style)
V.text: 结束之前，把交付文件渲染成图片检查一遍：例如先用 LibreOffice 无界面模式把交付文件转换成 PDF，再把 PDF 转换成 PNG 图片，并用 read 工具查看这些图片。对照任务说明和输入材料（包括参考图片和原始文档）检查渲染结果：内容是否正确完整，排版和格式是否符合要求，有没有错位、重叠、溢出、乱码或缺失。发现问题就修改、重新保存并再次检查，确认没有问题后再结束。

blocks.design: Block b contains replicate b of every cell: 8 primary tasks x {O,F,T,V} plus officeval_085 x F = 33 runs. Any prefix of complete blocks is balanced.

totals.expected_logical_requests: about 3,600-4,600 (DEV45 mean 21.4 requests per run; F/T/V are expected to add 0-40%)
totals.expected_gpu_hours: about 3 hours per block (DEV45 sustained about 282 requests/hour at concurrency 3); worst case about 4.1 hours per block; five separate six-hour leases

analysis.endpoint: study-outcome-v1 study_outcome_y, i.e. official OfficeVal completion_rate in [0,1]; study-invalid runs are excluded from means and counted
analysis.task_weighting: equal weight per primary task; cell mean first, then contrast, then average over tasks
analysis.decision_basis: G1 uses the F-O point estimate and its two-stage bootstrap 95% lower bound; the T/V share rules compare point estimates (best of T and V chosen by point estimate); futility uses the F-O upper bound. Bootstrap intervals for T-O and V-O are reported, not used for the decision.

drift.compare: concurrent O vs DEV45 O on the 8 primary tasks

source_rule.note: Coarse frozen rule from the direction document section 2.2; officeval_033 pending review. Descriptive only.

decision_rules.label: stop_futility
decision_rules.when: after at least 3 complete blocks: upper 95% bound of F-O < 0.10
decision_rules.action: stop remaining blocks; the information gap is not binding for this pi

decision_rules.label: no_go_information_not_binding
decision_rules.when: final: F-O < 0.15 or its lower 95% bound <= 0
decision_rules.action: stop this direction for this pi; report

decision_rules.label: stop_existing_methods_sufficient
decision_rules.when: final: G1 holds and max(T-O, V-O) >= (2/3)(F-O)
decision_rules.action: existing text/render baselines already close most of the gap; the method contribution would be marginal

decision_rules.label: partial_requires_user_decision
decision_rules.when: final: G1 holds and (1/3)(F-O) <= max(T-O, V-O) < (2/3)(F-O)
decision_rules.action: user decides; any method must beat the best of T and V

decision_rules.label: go_method_development
decision_rules.when: final: G1 holds and max(T-O, V-O) < (1/3)(F-O)
decision_rules.action: proceed to acceptance compilation development on DEV; held-out families stay unexposed

operational_stops: Any integrity, provenance, source or service-identity error stops the block (fail closed; no automatic retry or resampling).
If more than 20% of a block's runs are study-invalid, pause before the next block and diagnose; do not change the frozen conditions to continue.
No lease renewal, no automatic restart, no replacement of invalid runs; missing cells are reported.
not_in_scope: Held-out families (only the 8 primary DEV tasks plus 085 F).
Analyst models, D1/D2/D3, checkpoint continuation branches.
Any change to tasks, verifiers, budgets, model, harness or image.
